event.title: Panic and Protests Follow Deaths of 37 Miners in Nigerian Custody
event.canonical_title: Panic and Protests Follow Deaths of 37 Miners in Nigerian Custody
event.summary: In Nigeria, 37 suspected illegal gold miners died while in custody, prompting protests in Minna. Survivors described a harrowing struggle for breath in an overcrowded prison cell. In response to the unrest, police fired teargas at demonstrators and imposed a curfew. Authorities are investigating the cause of the deaths, with some reports indicating overcrowding and poor ventilation may have contributed.

timeline.title: Panic and Protests Follow Deaths of Miners in Nigerian Custody
timeline.summary: In Nigeria's Minna, 37 suspected illegal goldminers died in a prison cell, prompting panic among survivors who struggled to breathe. Protests erupted in response, leading police to fire teargas and impose an overnight curfew. Armed security forces have been deployed to manage the unrest following the incident, which has drawn significant public outcry.

timeline.title: Nigeria Forms Panel to Investigate Deaths of 37 Miners in Custody
timeline.summary: The Nigerian government has established a 10-member independent panel to investigate the deaths of 37 suspected illegal gold miners in a holding cell operated by a paramilitary civil defense force. Survivors have described their distressing experiences in detention, while protests erupted in Minna, leading to police deploying tear gas and imposing a curfew. Families of the deceased are demanding justice following the incident.
